row.title: Pérez López 1974 ingested; both verdicts on every action (FREELY-ADAPTIVE-1)
row.body: Every settled action gets an effectiveness verdict (its own) and an efficiency verdict (another essential variable of its scope left its limits while it was open). Inconsistent action classes file Q-FAS items; the three survival levels are the essential variable survival_levels.
